name: indiigo-rm2-ssh
description: indiigo reMarkable SSH: extra reMarkable 2 actions that need SSH access, such as deleting documents

ssh_host.title: SSH host for the tablet over Wi-Fi
ssh_host.description: An SSH host with key login to the tablet as root, for example rm2 from ~/.ssh/config. Over the USB cable the plugin uses root@10.11.99.1 instead.
